title: REQ · buildSpriteSheet lays equal-size frames into one horizontal sheet with size and frame metadata
summary: A pure function converts frame grids into a single RGBA sheet and reports width, height, frame size and count.
description: Context: sprites are animation frames, each a palette-indexed grid. Desired behaviour: buildSpriteSheet(frames) validates that frames is non-empty and all share width and height (else throws Error), converts each with gridToRgba and places them left to right. Returns { width: frameWidth*count, height: frameHeight, frameWidth, frameHeight, frameCount, data }. Expected result: sheet metadata matches what SG-1.3 will write into the manifest. Why: manifest needs real size, frame size and frame count.
acceptance_criteria: Given 4 frames of 32x48, when built, then width 128, height 48, frameWidth 32, frameHeight 48, frameCount 4.
Given frame k, when read at x offset k*frameWidth, then its pixels equal gridToRgba of that frame.
Given an empty list or frames of different sizes, when built, then it throws.
Given a frame with an out-of-range index, when built, then it throws.
technical_constraints: Palette of at most 48 colours defined once.
